notes: The first Gottlieb System 3 recording, and the one that explains why System 3 games posted only at close (Krobs' Freddy, 2026-10-31; this table on 0.2.27 posted 'abandoned on ball 0' at exit). System 3 clears the ball byte (0x15: 0x03 -> 0x00 at t=206.5, then 0x80 at t=206.9, the idle bit) about 3.5 s BEFORE it clears player_count (0x201, which the map reads inverted as game_over, t=210.1). The detector's game-over rule needed a ball in play in the previous state, so the last ball and the game end were never derived; the fix remembers the last ball in play. WPC keeps the ball byte at 3 across game over (mm_109c fixtures) and Data East clears both in one step (tftc_400), which is why neither showed it.
